Name: Enhanced Bone Mill
Author: AxelotlTheGreat
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds the enhanced bone mill. This recipe can be purchased from Mr. Qi's Walnut Room. It works exactly like the original bone mill, but it produces hyper speed-gro, deluxe fertilizer, or deluxe retaining soil instead.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Click the download button.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Unzip the file[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Drag the included folder into the mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- A new machine[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]- SMAPI[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Content Patcher[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Stardew 1.6[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Shout out to my dad @dhfraser for helping me with this mod.[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Enhanced Bone Mill
Manifest.Description: An upgraded bone mill that turns bones into premium island fertilizers.
